candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field.{u_2} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u_2} k] {G : Type u_3} {H : Type u_4} [inst_2 : Group.{u_3} G]
  [inst_3 : Group.{u_4} H],
  And
    (∀ {V W : Type u} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{u} V] [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u} k V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_2, u} k V]
      [inst_7 : AddCommGroup.{u} W] [inst_8 : Module.{u_2, u} k W] [FiniteDimensional.{u_2, u} k W]
      (ρ : Representation.{u_2, u_3, u} k G V) (σ : Representation.{u_2, u_4, u} k H W),
      Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, u_3, u} ρ →
        Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, u_4, u} σ →
          Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, max u_3 u_4, u} (Etingof.extTprod.{u_2, u_3, u_4, u, u} ρ σ))
    (∀ {M : Type u} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{u} M] [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u} k M] [FiniteDimensional.{u_2, u} k M]
      (τ : Representation.{u_2, max u_4 u_3, u} k (Prod.{u_3, u_4} G H) M),
      Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, max u_3 u_4, u} τ →
        Exists.{u + 2} fun V =>
          Exists.{u + 2} fun W =>
            Exists.{u + 1} fun x =>
              Exists.{max (u + 1) (u_2 + 1)} fun x_1 =>
                Exists.{0} fun x_2 =>
                  Exists.{u + 1} fun x_3 =>
                    Exists.{max (u + 1) (u_2 + 1)} fun x_4 =>
                      Exists.{0} fun x_5 =>
                        Exists.{max (u + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun ρ =>
                          Exists.{max (u + 1) (u_4 + 1)} fun σ =>
                            And (Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, u_3, u} ρ)
                              (And (Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, u_4, u} σ)
                                (Exists.{u + 1} fun e =>
                                  ∀ (gh : Prod.{u_3, u_4} G H) (m : M),
                                    Eq.{u + 1}
                                      (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} e
                                        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
                                          (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1),
                                              u + 1}
                                            τ gh)
                                          m))
                                      (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
                                        (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1),
                                            u + 1}
                                          (Etingof.extTprod.{u_2, u_3, u_4, u, u} ρ σ) gh)
                                        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} e m)))))
